actualNative.description: Original guest completes the SEC mux RMW and the second real encryption-fuse branch, then reaches the unimplemented Key Manager memory power word. This does not implement KM reset or crypto.

contracts: SEC owns onlyPCR6009613c, with source0/2 and documented named POR0; unknown selectors, reset and reserved requests remain unsupported. Strict exact-owner refusals become ModelLimit without new trap state; adjacent/off-profile mapping is unchanged.

Actual PLL observation, not SEC selection, qualifies the pre-DPA480M input. PCR divider tap gates do not control that direct input. TRM limits downstream CRYPTO_CLK to160M through a separate DPA policy; no KM functional clock or ready event is derived here.
Three Bus/plain+UnitCost guest checks cover actual RMW without false PLL readiness, invalid-request trap/destination preservation, CPU/HP/raw retention and prior watchdog boundary.

SpiSdCard observations copy existing latched counters only. nativeCommandCalls excludes wrapper-handled SPI commands and includes failures; storageBlocksLoaded precedes reply/MISO consumption; storageBlocksWritten proves backing-store block commitment. Neither means guest completed a read, mounted FAT or flushed a file.

LCD/SD u64 counters are canonical decimal strings through the existing diagnostics ABI, worker allowlist and bounded parser. Same-card snapshots do not consume replies/reset counters; replaced workers are isolated; no new trait, ABI, hot byte/tick path or UI is added.

reviews.scope: Independent read-only cold diagnostics/source/lifecycle scope; no P1/P2, twelve file fingerprints stable. Helper old counter wording separately marked for follow-up; no independent execution or full product acceptance.

Independent read-only SEC owner and exact Bus classification/three guest fixtures/source pins/491 logs review; no P1/P2 in scope, all initial/final source fingerprints stable. No independent execution or KM/product acceptance.

negativeResults.description: The real-worker test initially failed before guest startup because this checkout had no generated web/wasm/esp32sim.wasm. This was a missing documented build prerequisite, not a mock fetch or emulator defect. The next run first built the actual production artifact; no fixture or assertion was weakened.

limits: Original factory remains before app_main/LCD/buttons/TF and ordinary watchdog startup. No KM/crypto/RF/PHY or physical power/timing claim.
Full default-LTO native workspace CI, identical-work CPU controls, original-factory production WASM/browser and fresh product acceptance remain required.
Raw logs and absolute private paths are excluded; artifact hashes, exact commands, compact results and explicit assumptions are retained.
